questions.question: In a prophet's message about the days to come, the LORD said He would pour out His Spirit on which people?
In a prophet's message about the days to come, the LORD said He would pour out His Spirit even on whom?
In a prophet's message, the sun turns dark and the moon turns to blood before what comes?

answers.text: The great and awesome Day of the LORD
The great harvest of the autumn rains
The return of the great locust army

questions.question: In a prophet's message about the Day of the LORD, who did the LORD say will be saved?

answers.text: Everyone who calls on the name of the LORD
Everyone who was born inside Jerusalem
Everyone who never broke a single law
